thread.title: Boeing Co. and Apple's stocks contribute about 120 points to Dow's 400-point afternoon rally - MarketWatch

author: Mark Decambre
title: Boeing Co. and Apple's stocks contribute about 120 points to Dow's 400-point afternoon rally - MarketWatch
text:
Published: Feb 12, 2018 12:32 p.m. ET Share Mark DeCambre 
The Dow Jones Industrial Average on Monday was rising by more than 400 points, as the blue-chip benchmark was buoyed by solid gains in shares of Apple Inc. and Boeing Co. The pair of Dow components were contributing more than 120 points to the Dow DJIA, +1.69% The average was up $11.25, or 3.4%, at 344.14, while shares of Apple AAPL, +3.97% rose 4%, or $6.15, to $162.55. A $1 move in any one of the Dow's components equates to a 6.83-point swing in the price-weighted average. Shares of General Electric Co. GE, -0.78% was the only laggard among Dow components. The Dow was recently up 444 points, or 1.8%, at 24,631, as the benchmark attempted to post its second straight gain after U.S. stocks got rocked last week, putting in their worst stretch of gains since early 2016, with all of the main benchmarks posting a loss of at least 5% for the week. Most recently, the S&P 500 index SPX, +1.40% meanwhile, was up 1.5% at 2,659, while the Nasdaq Composite Index COMP, +1.48% advanced 1.6% at 6,983. Quote References
